# Rezo Shmertz

> Founder, investor, and researcher working across crypto markets, capital formation, confidential AI, and public research.

## Research

- [Bitcoin Cycle Roadmap](https://rezoshmertz.com/research/): A historical cycle scenario framework; not a prediction.
- [What Money Would AI Choose?](https://rezoshmertz.com/research/ai-money/): 1,260 model decisions across 28 scenarios, four functions of money, and five frontier models, with downloadable data.

## Writing and Public Record

- [Writing, conversations, press, and appearances](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/)
- [Warren Buffett, AI Agents, and Why Your Edge Was Never About Thinking](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/warren-buffett-ai-agents-edge/): Rezo Shmertz on what remains scarce when AI makes analysis abundant: judgment, trust, distribution, responsibility, and the ability to act.
- [Non-Custodial Isn't Enough: Why Perp DEXs Need Transparency](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/non-custodial-perp-dex-transparency/): Self-custody removes one class of exchange risk, but credible perpetual markets also require transparent execution, liquidations, incentives, and solvency.
- [The Quantum Threat to Bitcoin: We Can't Predict the Timeline](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/quantum-threat-to-bitcoin/): Bitcoin's quantum risk has an unknowable deadline. Rezo Shmertz argues for address hygiene, post-quantum research, and upgrade optionality without panic.
- [Bitcoin Doesn't Compete with Ethereum and Solana](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/bitcoin-ethereum-solana-monetary-systems/): Bitcoin behaves like digital gold while Ethereum and Solana resemble productive economic layers. Rezo Shmertz explains why the systems are complementary.
- [Ethereum, Conviction & What Gets Passed to the Next Generation](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/ethereum-conviction-next-generation/): A BR Labs conversation with Rezo Shmertz on Ethereum neutrality, institutional wrappers, stablecoins, self-custody, and inherited conviction.
- [AI as the New Baseline, Trust Over UX & Sharpening Conviction](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/ai-trust-conviction/): A BR Labs conversation with Rezo Shmertz about AI leverage, hiring, institutional distribution, invisible interfaces, wallet adoption, and trust.
- [Solana After FTX, OUSD Redistribution & Retail Conviction](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/solana-ousd-retail-conviction/): A BR Labs conversation with Rezo Shmertz on Solana after FTX, value capture, OUSD redistribution, payment rails, and retail conviction.
- [Robinhood’s Gated DeFi, Ethereum Rails & Nation-State Bitcoin](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/robinhood-gated-defi-ethereum-bitcoin/): Rezo Shmertz on Robinhood's gated DeFi distribution, Ethereum settlement and lessons from El Salvador's Bitcoin adoption in BR Labs Episode 4.
- [Tokenized RWAs, Open vs Permissioned DeFi & Retail’s New Role](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/tokenized-rwas-open-permissioned-defi/): Rezo Shmertz discusses tokenized real-world assets, institutional distribution, DeFi composability and retail participation in BR Labs Episode 5.
- [Intent Economy, Solvers & Agentic Trading](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/intent-economy-solvers-agentic-trading/): Rezo Shmertz explains intent-based trading, solver auctions, BRRRolver on Base and Ethereum, and the role of capital in BR Labs Episode 6.
- [Bitcoin at $80K, Market Triggers & Wrappers vs Native Assets](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/bitcoin-market-triggers-native-assets/): Rezo Shmertz discusses Bitcoin from holder and trading-desk perspectives, market triggers and asset wrappers versus native tokens in BR Labs Episode 7.
- [Tokenized Equities, Robinhood Distribution & Crypto Still King](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/tokenized-equities-robinhood-distribution/): Rezo Shmertz discusses tokenized stocks, Robinhood's distribution, crypto market flows and wrappers versus native assets in BR Labs Episode 8.
- [Early Bets, Liquid vs Venture & Why Math Is Honest](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/early-bets-liquid-venture-investing/): Rezo Shmertz reflects on early investments, CoW Swap, Pave Bank and the different feedback cycles of liquid and venture investing in BR Labs Episode 9.
- [VC After AI Concentration, the Desk Map & One Unified Book](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/conversations/vc-ai-concentration-unified-book/): Rezo Shmertz on AI venture investing, founder adaptability, BRRRolver and the goal of a unified CeFi and DeFi trading book in BR Labs Episode 10.
- [Corporate L1s and regulatory arbitrage](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/press/public-blockchains-regulatory-standard/): CryptoSlate quotes Rezo's contrasting view in a debate on public and corporate blockchains.
- [Strategy, Bitcoin, and the cost of conviction](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/press/strategy-bitcoin-cost-of-conviction/): Crypto Briefing cited Rezo's response to Peter Schiff's comparison of Strategy's Bitcoin returns, including the timing of its purchases.
- [Stablecoins at the Tbilisi Finance Summit](https://rezoshmertz.com/writing/appearances/stablecoins-tbilisi-finance-summit/): Rezo Shmertz took part in a roundtable on stablecoins at the Tbilisi Finance Summit in October 2025. GFTN's event gallery documents the appearance.
